title: Tlhologelelo mo Phaposing e e Boitshepo
intro: O tsena mo lefelong le le boitshepo le le didimetseng mme o bona motlhanka yo o ineetseng wa ga Allah a eme ka thapelo. Diatla tsa bone di tsholeditswe, matlho a bone a tsholetsegile, mme pelo ya bone e rwele tlhologelelo e e tsereng botshelo jotlhe. Ke mang moya ono o o pelotelele o tshepo ya one mo go Allah e sa kang ya reketla?
clues: Ke ne ka fetsa dingwaga tse dintsi ke obamela le go rapela, ke bona dikgakgamatso tse di neng tsa nonotsha tumelo ya me.
Ke ne ka newa boikarabelo jwa go tlhokomela mowa o mosha o o segofaditsweng mo lefelong le le boitshepo.
Fa ke ntse ke tsofala, kutlobotlhoko ya me e kgolo e ne e le gore ke ne ke se na ngwana, ka gonne mosadi wa me o ne a le moopa mme re setse re godile ka bobedi jwa rona.
Ke ne ka rapela Morena wa me gore a nne le motlhatlhami go tswa mo lelapeng la gaetsho, motho yo o neng a tla tsweletsa boswa jwa boporofeti.
Fa ke ntse ke eme mo lefelong la thapelo, baengele ba ne ba mpitsa, ba re, ‘Allah o go naya dikgang tse di itumedisang’, mme ke ne ka itewa ke letshogo le kgakgamalo.
Ke ne ka bolelelwa gore ke tla nna le morwa yo o bidiwang Yahya, leina le le iseng le ko le newe ope pele, mme jaaka sesupo ga ke kitla ke bua le batho malatsi a le mararo.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
